title: Tachyon schedule declaration (.tachyon/schedules/<name>.yml)
description: One schedule — fires on an interval ('every') or at a wall-clock time ('at'), exactly one, and spawns a declared agent ('spawn'). The exactly-one rule is enforced by the product, not this schema. The file's mapping is the declaration; the name is the filename.

spawn.description: Name of an agent declared in this workspace.

instructions.description: Prompt handed to the spawned agent. Only valid alongside 'spawn'.

catchUp.description: Run once on startup when the window was missed while the editor was closed.
